neighbours.label: Dense, mixed early-layer pole: fires on the token ' helpful' after a copula/modal (is/be/not helpful), and more weakly on ' thus', ' health' and Chinese '深入'; no single meaning covers the strong activations
fire: When a toddler melts down in the store, it may be helpful to crouch down and speak quietly.
Reading the manual twice was not helpful, since half the pages described a different model.
Our budget is tight and the deadline is near, and thus we must cut the optional features.
The clinic has expanded its public health programs to cover three more counties this year.
I thought it would be helpful to write the steps on a card and tape it to the fridge.
The council ignored the warnings, and thus the bridge stayed open through the whole storm season.
Given the serious environmental and health risks, the town voted to close the old plant.
Is the extra detail helpful, or does it just clutter the report for readers?
quiet: When a toddler melts down in the store, it may be useful to crouch down and speak quietly.
Reading the manual twice did not clear things up, since half the pages described a different model.
Our budget is tight and the deadline is near, so we must cut the optional features.
The clinic has expanded its nursing programs to cover three more counties this year.
I figured it would be easier to write the steps on a card and tape it to the fridge.
The council ignored the warnings, therefore the bridge stayed open through the whole storm season.
Given the serious environmental and safety risks, the town voted to close the old plant.
Does the extra detail clarify anything, or does it just clutter the report for readers?

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Pole is dense (14% of tokens above 0.1 of max) and the top examples are ' helpful' after copulas, but the band >=0.5 samples are a mix (' thus', ' health', 'healthcare', Japanese '心'), so the label is a short word list that will likely only partly cover the pole. Near misses use synonyms (useful, therefore, safety) as hard edges.
